{{Quote|Betty's my custom JG-1 landspeeder. I named her after Darth Betton, this really gorgeous&mdash;|Tyrak|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
"'''Betty'''" was the nickname that [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] gave to his [[JG-1 landspeeder]]. He named the vehicle after an attractive [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Darth Betton]].
